nodes.name: scanner.rs
nodes.summary: Core SkillsLoader implementation: a builder-configured, cache-backed scanner that discovers SKILL.md files across builtin/workspace/global/extra source directories, parses YAML frontmatter, applies disabled-skill and agent-scoping filters, and renders a token-budgeted skill listing for the system prompt.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a 2-second SWR (stale-while-revalidate) cache keyed on a hashable SkillScanKey struct so repeated turns in the same workspace avoid re-walking the filesystem.

nodes.name: skill_env_storage.rs
nodes.summary: Persists and loads user-supplied environment variables required by skills (e.g. API keys) to a JSON file, and applies them to the process environment on load.

nodes.name: source_dirs.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves extra skill source directories and lazily unpacks the bundled ai-research-skills archive into a well-known directory on first use.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Shared data types for the skills system: SkillInfo (the full per-skill descriptor surfaced to the frontend), SkillListingEntry, SkillMetadata (parsed frontmatter), and the DescriptionQuality classification enum.

nodes.name: browse.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists the Skills Hub marketplace with no search query, delegating to the same search endpoint used by skills_hub_search.

nodes.name: cache.rs
nodes.summary: Reads and writes a per-skill on-disk JSON cache of Skills Hub detail responses so repeated detail lookups avoid a network round trip.

nodes.name: detail.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command that fetches full detail (stats, owner, changelog, SKILL.md content) for a single Skills Hub listing by slug.

nodes.name: http.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the shared reqwest HTTP client and holds the skills.sh base URL constants used by every Skills Hub endpoint.

nodes.name: install.rs
nodes.summary: Fetches a skill snapshot from Skills Hub, safely extracts its files under the target skill directory (guarding against path traversal), and exposes the install/uninstall Tauri commands plus frontmatter-scalar extraction helpers used to build the post-install detail response.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a SkillsLoader for a given workspace path with default (empty) source configuration.

nodes.name: with_extra_source_dirs
nodes.summary: Builder method adding extra skill source directories to scan.

nodes.name: list_skills
nodes.summary: Returns the current skill listing, transparently using the SWR cache when the entry is still fresh and triggering a background revalidation otherwise.

nodes.name: invalidate_cache
nodes.summary: Drops the cached scan result for this loader's cache key so the next list_skills call re-scans the filesystem.

nodes.name: scan_skills_uncached
nodes.summary: Performs a full filesystem scan across all configured source directories and returns the resulting skill set, bypassing the cache.

nodes.name: default_workspace_skill_source_dirs
nodes.summary: Computes the default set of skill source directories to scan for a workspace (project-local, global, and optional home-root skill directories).

nodes.name: discover_skill_source_dirs
nodes.summary: Walks a root directory looking for nested directories that themselves qualify as skill source roots (contain a SKILL.md within the scan depth).

nodes.name: skill_root_has_skill_md
nodes.summary: Checks whether a candidate root directory contains a SKILL.md file within the allowed recursion depth.

nodes.name: skill_root_has_skill_md_inner
nodes.summary: Recursive depth- and cycle-guarded helper for skill_root_has_skill_md, tracking visited directory entries to avoid infinite loops on symlinks.

nodes.name: apply_disabled_skills
nodes.summary: Marks scanned skills as disabled based on the loader's disabled-skills set.

nodes.name: load_skill_with_path
nodes.summary: Loads a single skill's full content and path by name, searching source directories in priority order and falling back to built-in skills.

nodes.name: get_always_skills
nodes.summary: Returns the subset of skills flagged `always: true` in frontmatter, which are unconditionally included in the prompt.

nodes.name: build_always_skills_manifest_section
nodes.summary: Renders the always-included skills into a system-prompt manifest section.

nodes.name: build_skill_listing_entries
nodes.summary: Builds the lightweight SkillListingEntry list (name/source/description/availability) used for the discovery listing, applying disabled-skill and agent-scope filters.

nodes.name: format_skill_listing_entries
nodes.summary: Formats listing entries into rendered text lines grouped for the system prompt.

nodes.name: listing_entry_description
nodes.summary: Selects the description text to display for a listing entry, substituting a placeholder when the description quality is poor.

nodes.name: render_listing_line
nodes.summary: Formats a single skill listing entry as one prompt line (name, source, description).

nodes.name: render_listing_lines_within_budget
nodes.summary: Renders listing lines up to the char budget, truncating or dropping trailing entries once the budget is exhausted.

nodes.name: build_skill_listing_attachment
nodes.summary: Builds the full skill-listing prompt attachment (manifest header plus budgeted entry lines) injected into the system prompt.

nodes.name: scan_supplemental_dir
nodes.summary: Scans a single supplemental (extra) source directory for skills and merges results into the accumulator, skipping names already claimed by a higher-priority source.

nodes.name: scan_supplemental_dir_recursive
nodes.summary: Recursive worker for scan_supplemental_dir that walks nested directories looking for SKILL.md files.

nodes.name: scan_skills_dir
nodes.summary: Scans a top-level skills directory (workspace or global) for immediate skill subdirectories.

nodes.name: scan_skills_dir_recursive
nodes.summary: Recursive worker for scan_skills_dir supporting nested skill directory layouts.

nodes.name: scan_skill_dir
nodes.summary: Loads and parses a single skill directory's SKILL.md, populating a SkillInfo entry with metadata, bundled files, and requirement-check results.

nodes.name: load_skill_from_source_dir
nodes.summary: Locates and loads a named skill's SKILL.md from a specific source directory, searching nested paths.

nodes.name: find_skill_file_recursive
nodes.summary: Recursively searches a directory tree for a skill's SKILL.md by matching directory name.

nodes.name: skill_metadata_applies_to_agent
nodes.summary: Checks whether a skill's frontmatter include/exclude agent lists permit it to be surfaced to the current agent.

nodes.name: parse_inline_list
nodes.summary: Parses a YAML-ish inline list value (e.g. `[a, b, c]`) from a single frontmatter line.

nodes.name: parse_skill_metadata
nodes.summary: Parses a SKILL.md's YAML frontmatter block into a SkillMetadata struct, handling scalar fields, inline lists, and required-bins/env-vars declarations.

nodes.name: check_requirements
nodes.summary: Checks whether the binaries and environment variables a skill declares as required are actually present, returning the missing subsets.

nodes.name: truncate_listing_text
nodes.summary: Truncates listing text to a maximum character count, appending an ellipsis marker when truncated.

nodes.name: SkillScanKey
nodes.summary: Hashable cache key capturing the workspace, builtin dir, extra source dirs, agent id, and workspace-resource flag that together determine a skill scan's result set.

nodes.name: SkillsLoader
nodes.summary: Builder-configured scanner that discovers, caches, parses, and filters SKILL.md files across builtin/workspace/global/extra source directories and renders the token-budgeted skill listing injected into the system prompt.

nodes.name: load_skill_env
nodes.summary: Reads the persisted skill-environment JSON file from disk, returning an empty map if it doesn't exist yet.

nodes.name: load_and_apply_skill_env
nodes.summary: Loads the persisted skill environment variables and applies each one to the current process environment.

nodes.name: skill_env_save
nodes.summary: Tauri command that persists a full replacement set of skill environment variables to disk and re-applies them to the process.

nodes.name: source_dir_path
nodes.summary: Resolves an ExtraSourceDir enum value to its concrete on-disk path.

nodes.name: ensure_source_dirs
nodes.summary: Ensures each requested extra source directory exists on disk, unpacking bundled archives as needed.

nodes.name: ensure_ai_research_skills
nodes.summary: Lazily unpacks the bundled ai-research-skills archive into its target directory the first time it's requested, skipping if already present.

nodes.name: unpack_ai_research_archive
nodes.summary: Extracts the embedded ai-research-skills archive bytes into a destination directory.

nodes.name: DescriptionQuality
nodes.summary: Classification of a skill's frontmatter description quality (Good/Short/Missing), used to decide whether to substitute a placeholder in listings.

nodes.name: SkillInfo
nodes.summary: Full per-skill descriptor surfaced to the frontend: identity, source, availability/enabled flags, requirement checks, description quality, version/license/compatibility metadata, token estimates, and bundled file list.

nodes.name: SkillListingEntry
nodes.summary: Lightweight entry (name, source, description, availability) used to render the discovery-time skill listing without loading full content.

nodes.name: SkillMetadata
nodes.summary: Parsed SKILL.md frontmatter: name, description, always flag, version/license/compatibility, required bins/env vars, and agent include/exclude lists.

nodes.name: skills_hub_detail_cache_read
nodes.summary: Reads a cached Skills Hub detail response for a skill name from disk, returning None on missing/corrupt cache.

nodes.name: skills_hub_detail_cache_write
nodes.summary: Writes a Skills Hub detail response to the on-disk per-skill cache file.

nodes.name: skills_hub_detail
nodes.summary: Tauri command that fetches full detail for a Skills Hub listing by slug via HTTP.

nodes.name: build_http_client
nodes.summary: Constructs the shared reqwest client used for all Skills Hub HTTP requests, with timeout configuration.

nodes.name: split_skills_sh_slug
nodes.summary: Splits a skills.sh slug into its owner and skill-name components.

nodes.name: snapshot_skill_md
nodes.summary: Extracts the SKILL.md file content from a downloaded skill snapshot's file list.

nodes.name: fetch_skill_snapshot
nodes.summary: Downloads a skill's file snapshot (all bundled files + hash) from Skills Hub over HTTP.

nodes.name: safe_join_skill_file
nodes.summary: Joins a snapshot file's relative path onto the target skill directory, rejecting paths that would escape it.

nodes.name: install_skill_snapshot
nodes.summary: Writes every file in a downloaded skill snapshot to disk under the skill directory, creating parent directories as needed.

nodes.name: skills_hub_install
nodes.summary: Tauri command that downloads and installs a skill from Skills Hub by slug into the appropriate local skill directory.

nodes.name: build_detail_from_snapshot
nodes.summary: Builds a HubSkillDetail response object from a slug and its downloaded snapshot when the full detail endpoint isn't available.

nodes.name: skills_hub_uninstall
nodes.summary: Tauri command that removes an installed skill's directory from disk.

nodes.name: extract_frontmatter_scalar
nodes.summary: Extracts a single scalar YAML frontmatter field's value from raw SKILL.md content by key.
